title: Among all cards illustrated by 'Volkan Baǵa' that are not available in foil
question: Among all cards illustrated by 'Volkan Baǵa' that are not available in foil and have unknown power (null or '*'), find how many are of uncommon rarity, were released in a set between 2010 and 2020, and have at least one ruling. Additionally, ensure these cards are not banned in any format.

prediction.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1."XCL_001")
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T1."XCL_063" = T2."XCL_099"
WHERE T1."XCL_002" = 'Volkan Baǵa'
  AND T1."XCL_006" IS NULL
  AND (T1."XCL_055" IS NULL OR T1."XCL_055" = '*')
  AND T1."XCL_059" = 'uncommon'
  AND T2."XCL_112" BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2020-12-31'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM rulings AS T3
    WHERE T3."XCL_090" = T1."XCL_072"
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM legalities AS T4
    WHERE T4."XCL_086" = T1."XCL_072" AND T4."XCL_085" = 'Banned'
  )
